Author: TheKHD5
Name: Bestiary Nav
Description: Click a Bestiary entry to find its capture location or duty. Highlight nearby uncaptured beasts and optionally travel to them with Lifestream and vnavmesh. /bnav opens the Bestiary; /bnav config opens settings.
Changelog:
- Add Experimental BST farming with +1 to +5 target levels and area patrols.
- Move to stronger areas as you level; stop at your chosen target level.
- Optionally summon your chocobo and refresh selected inventory food.
- Add combat FATE participation and an Ignore Notorious Monsters toggle.
- Automatically return after incapacitation and resume farming.
